title: DRC Ebola Cases Consolidated Dataset Schema
description: Ground truth JSON Schema defining column structures, data types, date formats, enums, and required fields for drc_ebola_cases_consolidated.csv.

location_country.description: ISO3 country code representing the location

location_level.description: Administrative location level (e.g., 0 for national, 3 for health zone)

location_name_source.description: Original location name as reported in the source data

location_code.description: P-code or ISO code corresponding to the location

location_code_type.description: Type of location code identifier used

reference_date.description: Date of observation or report in YYYY-MM-DD format

source.description: Primary data source or SitRep document title

source_url.description: URL to the raw data file or source repository

source_indicator_name.description: Indicator name as defined in the raw source file

reporting_period_start.description: Start date for the reporting period

reporting_period_end.description: End date for the reporting period

last_updated.description: Timestamp/date when the record was last modified

data_quality_flag.description: Flag indicating manual data transcription or quality overrides

notes.description: Additional context or explanations regarding the data point
